actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.youform_get_form.description: Gets a form by its slug, including its questions and settings.
The form's slug, e.g. "kyir3qrg" (the `slug` field from List Forms, also the last part of the form's share link).
actions.youform_list_forms.description: Lists one page of forms in the account.
actions.youform_list_forms.props.page.de: Page number to return, starting at 1. Defaults to 1. Use the returned `current_page` and `last_page` to page through.
actions.youform_list_submissions.descrip: Lists one page of submissions for a form.
actions.youform_list_submissions.props.f: The form's slug, e.g. "kyir3qrg" (the `slug` field from List Forms, also the last part of the form's share link).
actions.youform_list_submissions.props.i: Complete or partial submissions only. Partial needs Pro. Unset returns all.
actions.youform_list_submissions.props.p: Page number to return, starting at 1. Defaults to 1. Use the returned `current_page` and `last_page` to page through.
actions.youform_list_submissions.props.s: Order by submission time. Defaults to oldest first.
auth.description: You can obtain API token from [Account Settings](https://app.youform.com/account).
triggers.new-submission.description: Triggers When a new submission is recieved.
